content.comment_body: Hello, I’m facing an issue where after editing and saving the network project, it won’t open and shows an "Unknown error." Is there a way to recover the project data or at least retrieve part of it? I’ve invested a lot of time and would prefer not to redo all the work.

Hi [user_name], which [version_no] did you use for the project? Do you have a backup available? Have you tried updating it or does it not open even offline? Sometimes project files can become corrupted. If that’s the case, I recommend reaching out to technical support to see if there's any chance of recovering it.

It sounds like the project is corrupted. While you might be able to recover individual LSC files, some Java errors can occur. There’s also an LNP project kept in the MNP project directory—possibly you upgraded LNP to MNP. Forum support is limited for this issue, so you should start a Support Request.
Thanks for the response. How do I restore individual LSC files? Even if I can recover part of the project, that would already be helpful.
All LSC files are included in the attachment.
Thank you very much, your help has been invaluable. Wishing you health, prosperity, and happiness.
I have everything except for money...

analysis.insight_summary: The main challenge discussed is project file corruption following edits and saving, resulting in an 'Unknown error' and concerns over data loss and recovery difficulty. Users are frustrated by the lack of internal recovery options and must escalate problems to technical support, exposing gaps in the product’s self-repair and recovery processes.
analysis.user_expectations: Users seek trustworthy data saving, straightforward error diagnostics, and a built-in recovery feature that allows restoration of corrupted or lost project files with minimal loss of work.
